name: Paliperidone
metabolism: Renal excretion of unchanged drug is the main route out of the body. CYP2D6/CYP3A4 show activity in the lab but contribute little to overall in-vivo how fast the body clears it. Paliperidone is also risperidone's active 9-hydroxy metabolite.
summary: Paliperidone is an atypical antipsychotic used to treat schizophrenia and schizoaffective disorder. It is available in oral and long-acting injectable formulations.
